_readme: THE PUBLIC STACK CONFIG -- same shape as tools/supervisor/start_chimera.py's DEFAULT_CONFIG,
but game_shell and website bind 0.0.0.0 so the internet can reach them (through the tunnel
described in docs/DEPLOY_RUNBOOK.md). The engine has NO AUTH and stays on 127.0.0.1:8107 --
never route, forward, or expose 8107. Health checks stay on 127.0.0.1 (run from this machine).
The engine exe is spawned DIRECTLY (no launch_chimera.bat: it detaches the engine with
`start ""`, so a watchdog child handle could never stop it on shutdown) -- the supervisor
